reported.title: No stop threshold / no hysteresis: pump stops immediately below 45 cm instead of at 30 cm
reported.description: The control logic at lines 71-78 only compares against START_CM (45.0) and turns the pump off in the else branch, so there is no 30.0 cm stop point and no latch between start and stop. The measured evidence shows D7 not HIGH for 2090 ms and 5000 ms intervals while level was still above the required start level, because any dip below 45 cm immediately drops the pump. The silence latch at lines 57-61 also forces the pump off and is never cleared, which is why D7 stayed low for 4500-5000 ms in the silence scenarios. D7 was in the wrong state for 2140 ms across 2 interval(s), first at 3.98 s: D7 was not HIGH for 2090 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Output chatters at threshold due to missing hysteresis and filtering
reported.description: Lines 71-78 compare the raw single ADC sample directly against 45.0 cm with no hysteresis band and no filtering, so noise around the threshold flips the pump on every 40 ms poll. The measured evidence shows 64 toggles in a 5000 ms window (limit 2) and 84 toggles over the run, and even a brief glitch produced 8 toggles. D7 toggled 64 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.32 s (limit 2), and 84 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

reported.title: Reported level is off by 0.2 cm because ADC scaling uses 5000 mV full scale
reported.description: Line 23 converts the ADC count with 5000.0f/1023.0f, but the ADC reference is the 5 V supply and the correct full-scale divisor is 1024, biasing every reading slightly high; combined with the 10 mV/cm scale this yields 29.8 cm printed for a 30.0 cm input. The measured evidence shows 9 of 9 values wrong, each off by 0.2 cm at 30.0 cm, exceeding the ±0.1 cm tolerance. Firmware printed 29.8 cm at 832 ms while the injected input was 30.0 to 30.0 cm: off by 0.2 cm (tolerance ±0.1). 9 of 9 values were wrong.

truth_for_judge.description: Single 45 cm start level short-cycles the pump

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (No short cycling)

judge_input.spec:
- Linear water-level sensor on A1 at 10 mV/cm; sump pump contactor on D7; silence pushbutton on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Start the pump when level reaches 45.0 cm or higher; stop the pump when level falls to 30.0 cm or lower.
- Holding D4 LOW latches silence mode and keeps the pump OFF until reset (power cycle).
- Pump output must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Every 800 ms print `sump cm=<level> pump=<0|1> mute=<0|1>` with level to one decimal place.
- Apply pump start/stop within 500 ms of a sustained band crossing.
